description_en: Creates a custom reserved CIDR block from an IPAM pool
description_zh: 从IPAM地址池创建自定义预留网段
kebab_example: aliyun vpcipam create-ipam-pool-allocation --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --ipam-pool-id ipam-pool-6rcq3tobayc20t0000 --region cn-hangzhou
name: CreateIpamPoolAllocation

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the region where you want to create the custom reserved CIDR block.

You can call https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/36063.html to obtain the region ID
parameters.help_zh:
要创建的自定义预留网段所在的地域ID。

您可以通过调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/36063.html接口获取地域ID
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the IPAM pool
parameters.name: ipam_pool_id

parameters.help_en:
The CIDR block to allocate from the IPAM pool.

You must specify either the Cidr or CidrMask parameter
parameters.help_zh:
通过输入地址段的方式从IPAM地址池创建自定义预留网段。

参数Cidr或CidrMask至少输入一个
parameters.name: cidr

parameters.help_en:
The mask of the CIDR block to allocate from the IPAM pool.

You must specify either the Cidr or CidrMask parameter
parameters.help_zh:
通过输入掩码的方式从IPAM地址池创建自定义预留网段。

参数Cidr或CidrMask至少输入一个
parameters.name: cidr_mask

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to perform a dry run. Valid values:

true: Sends a check request. The custom reserved CIDR block is not created. The system checks for required parameters, request format, and service limits. If the check fails, an error is returned. If the check passes, the DryRunOperation error code is returned.

false (default): Sends a normal request. After the request passes the check, a 2xx HTTP status code is returned and the custom reserved CIDR block is created
parameters.help_zh:
是否只预检此次请求。取值：

true：发送检查请求，不会创建自定义预留网段。检查项包括是否填写了必需参数、请求格式、业务限制。如果检查不通过，则返回对应错误。如果检查通过，则返回错误码DryRunOperation。
false（默认值）：发送正常请求，通过检查后返回HTTP 2xx状态码并直接创建
parameters.name: dry_run

parameters.help_en:
The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request. Generate a value on your client to make sure that the value is unique among different requests. The token can contain only ASCII characters.

If you do not specify this parameter, the system automatically uses the RequestId of the request as the ClientToken. The RequestId may be different for each request
parameters.help_zh:
客户端Token，用于保证请求的幂等性。从您的客户端生成一个参数值，确保不同请求间该参数值唯一。ClientToken只支持ASCII字符。

若您未指定，则系统自动使用API请求的RequestId作为ClientToken标识。每次API请求的RequestId不一样
parameters.name: client_token

parameters.help_en:
The description of the custom reserved CIDR block.

The description must be 1 to 256 characters in length. It must start with a letter or a Chinese character and cannot start with `http://` or `https://`. The default value is an empty string
parameters.help_zh:
自定义预留网段的描述信息。

长度为1～256个字符，必须以大小写英文字母或中文字符开头，但不能以`http://`或`https://`开头。不填则为空，默认值为空
parameters.name: ipam_pool_allocation_description

parameters.help_en:
The name of the custom reserved CIDR block.

The name must be 1 to 128 characters in length and cannot start with `http://` or `https://`
parameters.help_zh:
自定义预留网段的名称。

长度为1～128个字符，不能以`http://`或`https://`开头
parameters.name: ipam_pool_allocation_name

Cidr.description_zh: 创建的自定义预留网段

IpamPoolAllocationId.description_en: The ID of the custom reserved CIDR block
IpamPoolAllocationId.description_zh: 创建的自定义预留网段的实例ID
